title: Ing Siwala a Mekisanmetung karing Bunduk
intro: Ing metung a matulid a kaladwa mirinan yang pambihirang regalu ibat banua, meging yang metung a pekapun at metung a sundalus a ing kayang kalikasan balamu makasuglung ya king mismung pamaglalang. Ing karelang istorya mag-weave ya kapamilatan ning propesiya, panga-ari, at pamag-arte, likuan ne ing legacy a mag-echo kareng bulung ning banal a kapahayagan.
clues: Mepili ku bilang talasuyu nang Allah at mirinan yang masikan a kayarian libutad da ring mepiling tau.
Ding bunduk at ayup mag-echo la kanaku king pamagparangal king Kakataskatasan.
Ing bakal meging malambut ya kalupa ning gabun keng gamat ku, keng kaburian nang Allah mu.
ginawa kung proteksiun a baluti na magprotekta kareng sundalus keng pali ning labanan.
Misan mipasa ku keng masakit a pamagsubuk inyang ding adwang makipaglaban linub la keng kanakung lugal ning pamanyamba.
Mebanggit ku kayabe ning metung a pekapun a mig-utus king angin at karing jinn — uling ing pekapun a ita mismu yang anak ku.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
